# Format: https://llmstxt.org

> PYPE ERM is a comprehensive Education Resource Management (ERM) platform
> designed for Indian educational institutions. It enables full institutional
> management — from student admissions and sales pipelines to HR, payroll,
> collections, and finance — in a single unified web application.

## About PYPE ERM

PYPE ERM (Education Resource Management) is a SaaS-grade web platform
serving schools, colleges, coaching institutes, and study centres across India.
It is built to handle the complete lifecycle of an educational institution:
admissions, enrollments, student tracking, fee collections, HR management,
payroll processing, and performance monitoring.

**Website:** https://pypeerm.com  
**Region:** India  
**Currency:** INR (Indian Rupee ₹)  
**Language:** English (en-IN)

## Key Features

- **Student Management** — Full admission workflow, student profiles, enrollment tracking, document management, and status management (active, inactive, pending).
- **Sales Pipeline** — Lead management, direct student enrollment, sales agent dashboards, BDE tracking, and referral link generation for study centres.
- **Study Centre Onboarding** — Multi-branch study centre registration, document verification, program allocation, finance approval, and onboarding status tracking.
- **HR & Payroll** — Employee management, attendance tracking, leave management, salary configuration, payroll batch processing, and payslip generation.
- **Finance & Collections** — Invoice generation, payment schedule management, overdue tracking, fee reminder notifications (in-app + WhatsApp), and collections oversight dashboard.
- **Academic Management** — Program management, university affiliations, admission sessions, internal marks, and re-registration management.
- **Performance & KPI** — Employee performance tracking, KRA/KPI reports, target management, incentive structures, and CEO-level KPI dashboards.
- **Role-Based Access** — Multi-role architecture: Superadmin, Org Admin, Finance Admin, HR Admin, Operations Admin, Sales Admin, Sales Agent, BDE, CEOs, and Collections Overseers.

## Public Pages

- **Login / Home:** https://pypeerm.com/
- **Study Centre Registration:** https://pypeerm.com/register
- **Student Application Portal:** https://pypeerm.com/student-apply

## Target Users

- Educational institutions in India
- School administrators and principals
- College admission offices
- Coaching institute managers
- HR and payroll officers at educational organisations
- Finance and collections teams
- Sales teams managing student admissions

## Technology

PYPE ERM is a full-stack web application built with:
- **Frontend:** React (TypeScript), Vite, TailwindCSS
- **Backend:** Node.js, Express, TypeScript, Prisma ORM
- **Database:** PostgreSQL (hosted on AWS RDS)
- **Hosting:** AWS EC2 (India region)

## Contact & Support

- **Website:** https://pypeerm.com
- **Support:** admin@pypeerm.com
